payload.reason: The evidence indicates that not applying RR-based fingerprint construction would likely lead to lower signal-to-noise ratios (SNR) and reduced detection capabilities due to increased overfitting and variability in the model outputs.

claims.text: Without RR-based fingerprint construction, the model may suffer from overfitting, leading to lower SNR and less reliable detection of forced responses.
Regularisation in RR improves SNR by optimally projecting observations onto a regression coefficient pattern, enhancing detection performance.
Higher SNR is associated with more robust detection of forced climate change signals, which would be compromised without RR.
